doc: Custom asset manifest. Edit by hand or with `forge assets ...`; `forge assets sync` writes game/ReplicatedStorage/Config/AssetIds.luau from it. See docs/game/07-assets.md.

assets.prompt: cartoon red fire helmet with gold badge, low poly
assets.notes: 02 §5 helmet (HelmetRed #C0301E, gold shield). Trial generation 2026-10-23 in the Firefighter Mubit place; the Studio copy was deleted, ids kept. Number decal (01-04) still goes on top as a SurfaceGui.

assets.prompt: pair of big round cartoon googly eyes, white with small black pupils, low poly
assets.notes: 02 §5. v1 is part-built (pupils must jiggle); use the mesh only for the eye-white shells.

assets.prompt: chunky olive green firefighter work glove, thick cartoon fingers, open hand, cuff with reflective yellow band, low poly
assets.notes: 02 §9 viewmodel glove (GloveOlive). v1: open olive hand, chunky fingers, yellow reflective cuff band. Reads well; mirror it for the left hand.

assets.prompt: brass fire hose nozzle with red pistol grip, cartoon, low poly
assets.notes: 02 §9 viewmodel tool (BrassCoupling #C89A3C). Weld at GripR.

assets.prompt: firefighter pick-head axe, cartoon, long thin wooden handle like a broom stick, red metal head with one silver cutting blade on one side and a pointed spike on the other side, low poly
assets.notes: 02 §8 axe. v3: long straight wooden handle, red double-bit head with silver edges, chunky low poly. It ignores 'pick on the back' (every attempt was double-bit or a hatchet). The ids were read from the Studio instance because a playtest interrupted the CLI. Rejected: v1 short hatchet (75034553685862), v2 double-bit with a short handle (99956078812263).

assets.prompt: chubby cartoon firefighter potato body in tan coat with lime reflective bands, no head
assets.notes: 02 §13 v2 shell welded to the R15 rig; keep part-built eyes on top.

assets.prompt: chunky cartoon panda with big googly eyes and pink tongue, low poly
assets.notes: 02 §13: most important pet for the store pitch.

assets.prompt: chunky cartoon brown dog with big googly eyes and tongue out, low poly
chunky cartoon orange cat with big googly eyes, low poly
cartoon fire truck roof light bar, black base with one red light, one white light and one blue light, chunky, low poly
assets.notes: 02 §4 light bar. v1: black housing with red / white / blue lenses, matching TruckBuilder's LightRed/LightWhite/LightBlue. Has two small feet underneath.

assets.prompt: silver fire truck roof ladder, cartoon, low poly
assets.notes: 02 §6 truck detail (TruckChrome #D6D8DC).

assets.prompt: yellow fire hose coiled on a red reel, cartoon, low poly
assets.notes: 02 §6 truck side hose reel = refill point (tag Refill stays on the code-built part).

assets.prompt: front cab only of a cartoon fire engine, chunky boxy red cab, big windshield, round headlights, chrome grille and bumper, no rear body, no wheels, low poly toy style
assets.notes: Hero truck asset (02 §4 FireTruck, TruckRed #C8232B). generate_mesh ignores 'cab only / no wheels': both attempts came back as a whole stubby truck. This one (v2) is a chunky toy cab with one roll-up locker and wheels, no text (the number goes on as a SurfaceGui). Use it as the front half and put TruckBody behind it, or on its own as a compact truck. The ids were read from the Studio instance because a playtest started before the CLI could record publishedAssetId, so there's no _Model. Rejected v1 (full truck with mirrored '67') is kept as FireTruckHero.

assets.prompt: cartoon chunky red fire engine cab, front of a stylized toy fire truck, big windshield, round headlights, chrome grille and bumper, white number 67 on the side, low poly
assets.notes: Whole cartoon fire truck in one mesh (came out of the v1 TruckCab prompt). Reads great from the driver's side; the '67' texture is mirrored on the right side and the back, so cover those with a SurfaceGui or only show the left. Good for the station bay / title shot / far LOD. Mesh is 4.7x5.2x8 studs as generated; scale the MeshPart to ~10x10x27.

assets.prompt: thin flat slab-shaped red truck door, like a cartoon car door seen from the side, large square window in the top half, small chrome handle near the back edge, low poly
assets.notes: Hero truck asset. v3 (thin-slab prompt). The mesh comes out almost cubic (0.5^3): the door art (window + chrome handle) is on the +X face, so set MeshPart.Size to about 0.4 x 3.4 x 3.8 to flatten it into a door slab for DoorPanel_L/R. Rejected: v0 untextured block, v2 toy box with two handles.

assets.prompt: long red rectangular rear equipment box of a cartoon fire truck, longer than tall, three chrome roll-up compartment shutters along each side, white horizontal stripe, flat top, no wheels, no cab, low poly toy style
assets.notes: Hero truck asset (TruckRed, chrome roll-up shutters, white stripe). v2: long box with 3 shutters a side and a rear bumper. Its front face has small headlights, which are hidden against the cab. Rejected v1 (short toy cart with a water cannon on top). Replaces Body/BodyTop/Locker_*.

assets.prompt: chunky cartoon fire truck road wheel, smooth black tire with simple tread, big red rim with shiny chrome hub cap and lug nuts, low poly
assets.notes: Hero truck asset. v2: knobby black tyre with a red rim and chrome hub on the outer (+X) face. The inner face is plain, so mirror it for the left side. Rejected v1 (monster-truck tyre with a small grey rim).

assets.prompt: cartoon red fire truck with white side stripe, ladder on top and six wheels
assets.notes: 02 §13 v2 hero truck via generate_procedural_model (50/day quota). Needs the 67 SurfaceGui on top. If no publishedAssetId comes back, save it as a package by hand.

assets.prompt: burnt charred black wood with glowing ember cracks, cartoon
assets.notes: 02 §7 charred swap after a part burns out. MaterialVariant in MaterialService.

assets.prompt: warm red cartoon brick wall with cream mortar
assets.notes: 02 §6 FireStation walls (StationBrick).
02 §7 flame sprite sheet, FlipbookLayout Grid4x4. Fallback: rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds. Or draw one and switch source to upload with file images/fire_flipbook.png.
02 §7 smoke sheet. Fallback: rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds.
02 §10 HUD icon: fire objective / marker. 256x256 PNG, thick UiInk outline. File not drawn yet.
02 §10 HUD icon: rescue objective / marker. 256x256 PNG, thick UiInk outline. File not drawn yet.
